name: NAME
call_tip_body: State your location first, then describe the emergency. Stay calm and follow instructions.
What to do in an emergency: What to do in an emergency
When shaking starts, drop down and watch: When shaking starts, drop down and watch for falling objects
Take cover under a sturdy piece of furni: Take cover under a sturdy piece of furniture and hold on until the shaking stops
Once shaking stops, open a door and move: Once shaking stops, open a door and move calmly, protecting your head
Use the stairs, not elevators, and head: Use the stairs, not elevators, and head to a safe assembly point
Move away from buildings, power lines, a: Move away from buildings, power lines, and signs to an open area, and protect your head
Gather water, food, and essentials in a: Gather water, food, and essentials in a bag before water rises
Call 119 to report flooding and ask for: Call 119 to report flooding and ask for help if you are in danger
Move to higher floors or ground immediat: Move to higher floors or ground immediately and stay away from submerged cars
Head to a designated shelter and never c: Head to a designated shelter and never cross flooded roads or bridges
If you see a fire, press the alarm and s: If you see a fire, press the alarm and shout to alert others nearby
Call 119 (fire department) and report th: Call 119 (fire department) and report the location clearly
Cover your nose and mouth with a cloth a: Cover your nose and mouth with a cloth and stay low to avoid smoke
NEVER use elevators-take the stairs and: NEVER use elevators-take the stairs and evacuate to a safe place outside
